audio_prompt: A director wants the audience to feel trapped with a character during an interrogation. Which choice best supports that aim?

answers.text: Keep the camera tightly framed and avoid cutting to the wider room.
Use repeated aerial shots of the city.
Cut frequently to unrelated locations.
Show the entire building from far away.

explanation.summary: Restricted framing limits spatial escape and aligns the viewer closely with the character’s experience.
explanation.hint: Control what the audience can see.
